experiment_data.hypothesis: FewNERD temperature ablation (T=1.2): test how higher temperature affects degeneracy rate and SC diagnostic cascade on FewNERD, complementing SciERC T-ablation data. N=8, Qwen3-8B-FT, seed=42. Higher T should increase diversity and reduce degeneracy but degrade per-sample quality.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -u code/run_mvp_pilot.py --model_path checkpoints/qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged --data_dir data/fewnerd/ --dataset fewnerd --subtask ner --n_samples 8 --temperature 1.2 --seed 42 --collect_logprobs --output_dir output/fewnerd_t12_s42/

experiment_data.notes: T=1.2 on FewNERD: high oracle headroom (8.6%) but poor SC diagnostic correlation (rho_SJ=0.136 full, 0.213 conditional). High degeneracy (28.2% zero-F1 samples) and low per-sample quality (mean F1=0.55) indicate T=1.2 over-diversifies. Structural metric (SJ) still beats surface (Fleiss) by 0.075 rho advantage. Verdict: FAIL (MVP threshold not met on single subtask).
